name: Chicken Celebrity
description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful sweet and sour chicken recipe using onion soup mix and apricot jam.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together onion soup mix, apricot jam, and Russian dressing in a bowl.
Pour the mixture over the chicken in a baking dish.
Bake at 350°F for 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, easy chicken recipe, apricot jam chicken

_similar.name: Potato Soup
_similar.description: A creamy potato soup with carrots, onions, and bacon, finished with sour cream and butter for added richness.
recipeIngredient: 1 Oxo Chicken cube dissolved in 2 cups (8 oz) water + 1 cup water

recipeInstructions.text: Cook vegetables (potatoes, carrots) in 6 cups water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Microwave onions and butter until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked onion and butter mixture to the vegetables and stir.
Make a roux by stirring flour into 1 cup water until smooth, then add to the soup.
Add more water (up to 1 more cup) to achieve desired consistency.

_similar.keywords: potato soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese
